context: driven_minus has dense regions in 3/3 discovery seeds, while driven_plus/common_saddle_plus/no_bonds_plus do not. Work is consumed even without dense regions. A changed mean B population and equilibrium phase separation may explain the contrast; they must not be called fuel-maintained vessels.
analytic_control_reason: For eta1 and a common saddle, mu=-2 shifts the equilibrium configurational df from 1.2 to .2 exactly. The matched passive .2 control therefore has the same canonical stationary distribution, without chemical work. This is V, not new E evidence. Driven-minus with a different saddle is not assumed to share this distribution.
